_about: Single source for the sixty Shu points. Edit here, then run: python3 tools/sync-points.py. Element per station must follow Yin Wood>Fire>Earth>Metal>Water and Yang Metal>Water>Wood>Fire>Earth; verify any change against a live reference first.

channels.name: Liver
channels.startLoc: Lateral side of the great toe, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail
channels.endLoc: In the 6th intercostal space, on the mamillary line, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline
channels.pathway: Begins at the lateral/dorsal nail corner of the great toe (LR1), ascends the dorsum of the foot between the 1st and 2nd metatarsals (LR2, LR3 Taichong), passes 1 cun anterior to the medial malleolus (LR4 Zhongfeng), and ascends the medial lower leg along the medial border of the tibia. It crosses 8 cun above the medial malleolus behind the Spleen channel, passes the medial aspect of the knee crease (LR8 Ququan), and ascends the medial thigh to the groin. It encircles the external genitalia, enters the lower abdomen, ascends parallel to the Stomach channel, and connects internally with the Liver and Gallbladder. Penetrating the diaphragm, it spreads across the costal and hypochondriac region, terminating superficially at the 6th intercostal space at LR14 Qimen. An internal branch ascends along the esophagus and posterior pharynx to connect with the eye tissues, forehead, and vertex at GV20 Baihui. Another internal branch separates from the liver, crosses the diaphragm, and enters the lungs to connect with LU1, completing the continuous 12-channel cycle.

startDetails.loc: On the lateral side of the great toe, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail.

endDetails.loc: In the 6th intercostal space, on the mamillary line, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline.
endDetails.handoff: Internal branch crosses diaphragm into Lungs (LU1) to restart 12-channel cycle

organAffinities.tissues: Tendons · Ligaments · Eyes · Nails · External Genitalia · Hypochondrium

stages.title: Great Toe Dorsum & Pre-Malleolar Ascent
stages.desc: Begins at the lateral/dorsal nail angle of the great toe at LR1 Dadun, ascends the dorsum of the foot between the 1st and 2nd metatarsals through LR2 and LR3 Taichong (Yuan-Source), and passes 1 cun anterior to the medial malleolus at LR4 Zhongfeng.

stages.title: Tibial Decussation, Medial Knee & Groin
stages.desc: Ascends the medial margin of the lower leg along the tibia, crosses behind the Spleen channel 8 cun above the ankle, passes the medial end of the popliteal crease at LR8 Ququan, and courses up the medial thigh adductor canal to the pubic crest.

stages.title: Genital Encircling & Hypochondriac Terminus
stages.desc: Curves in a complete ring around the external genitalia, enters the lower abdomen, climbs parallel to the stomach, penetrates the Liver and Gallbladder, and arches through the diaphragm to spread over the costal margin, terminating superficially at LR14 Qimen in the 6th intercostal space.

stages.title: Cephalic Vertex Ascent & Pulmonary Handoff
stages.desc: A deep internal branch ascends through the throat and retro-ocular tissues to reach the vertex of the head at GV20 Baihui. Another internal vessel separates from the Liver, penetrates the diaphragm, and enters the Lungs to connect with LU1 Zhongfu, closing the continuous 12-meridian macro-circulation.

channels.name: Gallbladder
channels.startLoc: In the depression 0.5 cun lateral to the outer canthus of the eye
channels.endLoc: Lateral side of the 4th toe, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail
channels.pathway: Begins at the outer canthus of the eye (GB1), ascends to the temporal hairline, zig-zags across the temporal region, loops behind the ear to the occiput at GB20 Fengchi, curves back over the scalp to the forehead above the pupil (GB14), then sweeps back over the head to the crest of the shoulder (GB21 Jianjing). It enters the supraclavicular fossa (ST12), where internal branches descend through the chest to connect with the Liver and Gallbladder. The external branch descends down the lateral axillary line and ribcage (GB24, GB25), loops across the pelvis to the greater trochanter of the femur (GB30 Huantiao). It descends the lateral aspect of the thigh and knee, down the anterior margin of the fibula (GB34 Yanglingquan), passes anterior-inferior to the lateral malleolus (GB40 Qiuxu), traverses the dorsum of the foot between the 4th and 5th metatarsals (GB41 Zulinqi), and terminates at the lateral nail corner of the 4th toe at GB44 Zuqiaoyin. An internal foot branch separates at GB41 and runs to the great toe to link with LR1.

startDetails.loc: In the depression 0.5 cun lateral to the outer canthus of the eye.

endDetails.loc: Lateral side of the fourth toe, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail.
endDetails.handoff: Internal foot branch leaves GB41 to connect with LR1 Dadun (Great Toe)

organAffinities.tissues: Tendons · Sinews · Eyes · Temporal Region · Hips · Flanks

stages.title: Cranial Triple-Loop & Suboccipital Base
stages.desc: Originates at the outer eye canthus at GB1 Tongziliao, ascends to the temporal hairline, zig-zags across the temple, loops behind the ear to the suboccipital skull at GB20 Fengchi, curves back over the frontal scalp above the pupil (GB14), and sweeps over the shoulder crest at GB21 Jianjing.

stages.title: Supraclavicular Entry, Lateral Ribcage & Hip Joint
stages.desc: Dips into the supraclavicular fossa (ST12) sending deep vessels to link with Liver and Gallbladder; the superficial branch descends the mid-axillary line, zig-zags across the hypochondriac ribs (GB24, GB25), and loops over the greater trochanter at GB30 Huantiao.

stages.title: Lateral Thigh, Fibular Crest & Lateral Malleolus
stages.desc: Descends the iliotibial band of the lateral thigh, crosses the lateral knee crease, runs down the anterior margin of the fibula through GB34 Yanglingquan, and passes anterior-inferior to the lateral malleolus at GB40 Qiuxu.

stages.title: 4th Metatarsal Interspace to 4th Toe Terminus
stages.desc: Traverses the dorsum of the foot between the 4th and 5th metatarsal bones at GB41 Zulinqi, terminating at the lateral nail corner of the 4th toe at GB44 Zuqiaoyin. An internal collateral branches from GB41 and travels to the great toe nail to link with LR1 Dadun.

channels.name: Heart
channels.startLoc: In the center of the axillary fossa, on the medial side of the axillary artery
channels.endLoc: Radial side of the little finger, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail
channels.pathway: Originates deep within the Heart, descends through the diaphragm to connect with the Small Intestine. An ascending internal branch travels alongside the esophagus to the eye and brain. The main somatic branch traverses the lungs and emerges in the axilla at HT1. It descends the postero-medial border of the upper arm (medial to the biceps), passes the medial end of the cubital crease at the elbow (HT3 Shaohai), descends the anterior-medial forearm along the radial side of tendon flexor carpi ulnaris to the pisiform bone and wrist crease (HT7 Shenmen). It then crosses the hypothenar eminence of the palm (HT8) and terminates at the radial nail corner of the little finger at HT9 Shaochong, connecting directly with SI1.

startDetails.loc: In the center of the axillary fossa, on the medial side of the axillary artery.

endDetails.loc: Radial side of the little finger, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail.
endDetails.handoff: Immediate surface link to SI1 Shaoze at little finger

stages.title: Cardiocentric Origin & Deep Visceral Branches
stages.desc: Originates deep within the Heart, descends through the diaphragm to communicate with the Small Intestine; an ascending visceral branch travels up alongside the esophagus to connect with the ocular system, optic nerve, and brain.

stages.title: Pulmonary Traversal & Axillary Emergence
stages.desc: The main superficial trunk travels across the lung tissues and bursts forth in the center of the armpit at HT1 Jiquan, descending along the postero-medial aspect of the upper arm medial to the biceps muscle.

stages.title: Cubital Crease to Pisiform Bone
stages.desc: Passes the medial epicondyle of the humerus at HT3 Shaohai, descends the anterior-medial forearm along the radial side of the flexor carpi ulnaris tendon, and reaches the pisiform bone and wrist crease at HT7 Shenmen (Yuan-Source).

stages.title: Hypothenar Palm to Little Fingertip
stages.desc: Crosses the hypothenar eminence between the 4th and 5th metacarpal bones at HT8 Shaofu, and terminates at the radial nail corner of the little finger at HT9 Shaochong (Jing-Well), linking directly with SI1 Shaoze on the ulnar side.

channels.name: Small Intestine
channels.startLoc: Ulnar side of the little finger, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail
channels.endLoc: In the depression anterior to the tragus and posterior to the mandibular joint condyle
channels.pathway: Begins at the ulnar corner of the little fingernail (SI1), travels along the ulnar border of the hand (SI3 Houxi) and wrist (SI5), ascends the posterior-ulnar border of the forearm, and passes between the olecranon process and medial epicondyle of the humerus at the elbow (SI8 Xiaohai). It ascends the posterior upper arm to the shoulder joint, zig-zags across the infraspinous and supraspinous fossae of the scapula (SI9-SI13), meets the midline at the lower cervical spine (GV14 Dazhui), and curves forward over the shoulder into the supraclavicular fossa (ST12). An internal branch plunges downward to connect with the Heart, descends through the diaphragm to the Stomach, and enters the Small Intestine. The ascending superficial branch rises along the lateral neck (SI16, SI17), crosses the cheek to the outer canthus of the eye (linking to BL1), and enters the auditory canal, terminating in front of the tragus at SI19 Tinggong.

startDetails.loc: On the ulnar side of the little finger, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail.

endDetails.loc: In the depression anterior to the tragus and posterior to the mandibular condyle.
endDetails.handoff: Facial branch links with BL1 Jingming at inner canthus

organAffinities.tissues: Ears · Scapular Region · Upper Back · Lower Abdomen

stages.title: Digital Ulnar Ascent & Metacarpal Border
stages.desc: Begins at the ulnar nail angle of the little finger at SI1 Shaoze, courses along the ulnar margin of the hand past the 5th metacarpal head at SI3 Houxi, crosses the ulnar wrist crease at SI5 Yanggu, and climbs the posterior ulnar crest of the forearm.

stages.title: Olecranon Groove to Scapular Traversal
stages.desc: Passes between the olecranon tip and medial epicondyle of the humerus at SI8 Xiaohai, ascends the posterior triceps to the shoulder joint, and zig-zags across the infraspinous and supraspinous fossae of the scapula (SI9–SI13).

stages.title: Spinal Union & Visceral Penetration
stages.desc: Reaches the midline at the 7th cervical vertebra (GV14 Dazhui), arches forward into the supraclavicular fossa (ST12), and sends deep vessels down through the Heart, diaphragm, and Stomach to enter the Small Intestine.

stages.title: Cervical Ascent, Zygoma & Preauricular Tragus
stages.desc: The external ascending branch climbs the lateral neck, crosses the cheekbone, divides to send an internal link to the inner eye canthus (BL1), and enters the auditory canal, terminating directly in front of the tragus at SI19 Tinggong.

channels.name: Pericardium
channels.startLoc: In the 4th intercostal space, 1 cun lateral to the nipple, 5 cun lateral to the anterior midline
channels.endLoc: At the center of the tip of the middle finger (or 0.1 cun from the radial nail corner)
channels.pathway: Originates deep inside the chest in the pericardium, descends through the diaphragm into the abdomen to connect with the upper, middle, and lower burners (San Jiao). A lateral chest branch emerges at PC1 (1 cun lateral to the nipple), arches over the axilla, and travels down the antero-medial aspect of the upper arm between the two heads of the biceps brachii. It crosses the cubital fossa medial to the biceps tendon (PC3 Quze), runs down the midline of the anterior forearm between the tendons of palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis (passing PC5, PC6 Neiguan, and PC7 Daling at the wrist crease), traverses the center of the palm (PC8 Laogong), and terminates at the tip of the middle finger at PC9 Zhongchong. A collateral branch separates at PC8 and travels to the ulnar tip of the ring finger to connect with TB1.

startDetails.landmark: 4th Intercostal Space · 1 Cun Lateral to Nipple
startDetails.loc: In the 4th intercostal space, 1 cun lateral to the nipple, 5 cun lateral to the anterior midline.

endDetails.loc: At the center of the tip of the middle finger (or 0.1 cun from radial nail corner).
endDetails.handoff: Collateral from PC8 Laogong travels to TB1 Guanchong (Ring Finger)

organAffinities.tissues: Blood Vessels · Chest · Heart Envelope · Mind/Shen

stages.title: Cardio-Pericardial Origin & Three Burners
stages.desc: Originates deep inside the chest within the pericardium, plunges through the diaphragm into the abdomen, systematically connecting and harmonizing the Upper, Middle, and Lower Burners (San Jiao).

stages.title: Lateral Pectoral Emergence & Bicipital Arm
stages.desc: A chest branch emerges 1 cun lateral to the nipple at PC1 Tianchi, arches over the axilla, and travels down the antero-medial aspect of the arm between the two heads of the biceps brachii muscle.

stages.title: Cubital Fossa to Inter-Tendinous Forearm
stages.desc: Crosses the cubital fossa medial to the biceps tendon at PC3 Quze, descends the exact midline of the forearm between the tendons of palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis through PC6 Neiguan, and reaches the wrist crease at PC7 Daling.

stages.title: Palmar Center to Middle Fingertip
stages.desc: Crosses the center of the palm between the 2nd and 3rd metacarpals at PC8 Laogong, and terminates at the central tip of the middle finger at PC9 Zhongchong. An internal branch separates at PC8 to link with TB1 Guanchong on the ring finger.

channels.name: Triple Burner
channels.startLoc: Ulnar side of the ring finger, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail
channels.endLoc: In the depression at the lateral end of the eyebrow
channels.pathway: Begins at the ulnar nail corner of the ring finger (TB1), traverses the dorsum of the hand between the 4th and 5th metacarpal bones (TB3 Zhongzhu), over the dorsal wrist crease (TB4 Yangchi), and ascends the dorsal midline of the forearm between the radius and ulna (TB5 Waiguan, TB6 Zhigou). It passes the tip of the olecranon at the elbow (TB10 Tianjing), ascends the posterior upper arm to the shoulder (TB14), crosses the trapezial ridge (TB15), meets GV14 at the spine, and enters the supraclavicular fossa (ST12). Internally, it descends into the chest, connects with the Pericardium, and penetrates the diaphragm to link the Upper, Middle, and Lower Burners (San Jiao). The ascending superficial branch rises along the neck to the posterior base of the ear (TB17 Yifeng), curves around the posterior and superior rim of the ear, enters the ear, emerges anterior to the ear, crosses the cheek, and terminates in the depression at the lateral tip of the eyebrow at TB23 Sizhukong, linking with GB1 at the outer eye canthus.

startDetails.loc: On the ulnar side of the ring finger, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail.

endDetails.loc: In the depression at the lateral end of the eyebrow.
endDetails.handoff: Superficial facial branch links with GB1 Tongziliao at outer canthus

organAffinities.tissues: Water Metabolism · Fluid Passages · Lymphatics · Ears · Temples

stages.title: Digital Ulnar Genesis & Dorsal Hand
stages.desc: Commences at the ulnar nail angle of the ring finger at TB1 Guanchong, courses along the dorsum of the hand between the 4th and 5th metacarpals through TB3 Zhongzhu, over the dorsal wrist crease (TB4), and up the interosseous space of the forearm between radius and ulna (TB5, TB6).

stages.title: Olecranon Tip, Posterior Triceps & Shoulder
stages.desc: Climbs past the olecranon tip at TB10 Tianjing, ascends the posterior triceps surface to the shoulder at TB14, sweeps across the trapezius ridge (TB15), and converges at the spine at GV14 Dazhui.

stages.title: Supraclavicular Entry & San Jiao Visceral Drop
stages.desc: Enters the supraclavicular fossa (ST12), dives into the chest to connect with the Pericardium, and penetrates the diaphragm to link and coordinate the Upper, Middle, and Lower Burners (San Jiao).

stages.title: Auricular Circumference to Eyebrow Tip
stages.desc: The cervical branch ascends the side of the neck to retro-auricular TB17 Yifeng, loops around the ear helix into the auditory canal, re-emerges anterior to the ear, and terminates in the depression at the lateral end of the eyebrow at TB23 Sizhukong to meet GB1.

channels.name: Spleen
channels.startLoc: Medial side of the great toe, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail
channels.endLoc: On the mid-axillary line, in the 7th intercostal space (or 6th in some texts)
channels.pathway: Begins at the medial corner of the great toenail (SP1), runs along the junction of red and white skin on the medial border of the foot (SP2, SP3 Taibai), passes anterior-inferior to the medial malleolus (SP5), and ascends the postero-medial aspect of the tibia. It crosses anterior to the Liver channel at SP6 Sanyinjiao (8 cun above the malleolus), continues up the medial knee (SP9 Yinlingquan) and antero-medial thigh (SP10 Xuehai) to enter the lower abdomen at SP12. It traverses the abdomen (4 cun lateral to midline) connecting internally with the Spleen and Stomach, penetrates the diaphragm, ascends the chest (6 cun lateral to midline) to SP20, ascends the neck to spread over the lower surface of the tongue. An internal branch branches off in the chest to enter the Heart. A lateral superficial branch curves down the side of the ribcage to terminate at SP21 Dabao on the mid-axillary line as the Great Luo-connecting point of the Spleen.

startDetails.loc: On the medial side of the great toe, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail.

endDetails.loc: On the mid-axillary line, in the 7th intercostal space.
endDetails.handoff: Internal chest branch disperses into the Heart

organAffinities.tissues: Muscles · Flesh · Lips · Connective Tissues · Blood Vessels

stages.title: Medial Pedal Border & Malleolar Bypass
stages.desc: Begins at the medial nail angle of the great toe at SP1 Yinbai, courses along the junction of red and white skin past the 1st metatarsophalangeal joint at SP3 Taibai, and sweeps anterior and superior to the medial malleolus at SP5 Shangqiu.

stages.title: Tibial Cruciate Crossing & Medial Knee
stages.desc: Climbs the posterior-medial border of the tibia, crosses anterior to the Liver channel at SP6 Sanyinjiao (8 cun above the malleolus), passes the medial condyle of the tibia at SP9 Yinlingquan, and ascends the antero-medial thigh through SP10 Xuehai to the groin.

stages.title: Abdominal Route, Visceral Union & Lingual Root
stages.desc: Enters the lower abdomen at SP12, traverses 4 cun lateral to the midline connecting internally with the Spleen and Stomach, ascends through the diaphragm and chest (6 cun lateral) to SP20, and rises along the esophagus to disperse under the lower surface of the tongue.

stages.title: Cardio-Visceral Link & Great Luo (Dabao)
stages.desc: An internal branch departs the chest to enter the Heart. The superficial pathway sweeps downward and laterally across the side of the ribcage to terminate at SP21 Dabao in the 7th intercostal space, reigning as the Great Luo-connecting point over all collateral vessels.

channels.name: Stomach
channels.startLoc: Directly below the pupil, in the depression between the eyeball and the infraorbital ridge
channels.endLoc: Lateral side of the second toe, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail
channels.pathway: Begins beside the ala nasi (connecting from LI20), ascends to the inner canthus of the eye (BL1), then descends to the infraorbital ridge at ST1. It enters the upper gums, circles around the mouth to the chin (ST4, CV24), follows the lower jaw angle (ST6 Jiache), and ascends anterior to the ear to the coronal corner of the forehead at ST8 Touwei. A cervical branch descends from the jaw along the neck (ST9) into the supraclavicular fossa (ST12), where deep pathways plunge down through the diaphragm to enter the Stomach and connect with the Spleen. The superficial trunk branch descends across the mamillary line on the chest (4 cun lateral to midline) and abdomen (2 cun lateral to midline) down to the inguinal groove at ST30 Qichong. Continuing down the leg, it travels down the anterior thigh, over the patella and antero-lateral crest of the tibia (ST36 Zusanli), down the lower leg, over the dorsum of the foot (ST41, ST42), and terminates at the lateral nail corner of the 2nd toe at ST45. A branch from ST42 connects with SP1 on the great toe.

startDetails.loc: Directly below the pupil, in the depression between the eyeball and the infraorbital ridge.

endDetails.loc: Lateral side of the second toe, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail.
endDetails.handoff: Dorsal foot branch at ST42 connects with SP1 Yinbai (Great Toe)

organAffinities.tissues: Muscles · Mouth · Upper Teeth · Gums · Breast · Flesh

stages.title: Craniofacial Circuit & Mandibular Arch
stages.desc: Originates at the lateral nostril, ascends to the inner eye canthus (BL1), drops to the infraorbital ridge at ST1 Chengqi, enters upper gums, circles around the mouth to the chin groove, sweeps across the jaw angle at ST6 Jiache, and climbs anterior to the ear to the coronal skull at ST8 Touwei.

stages.title: Cervical Drop, Thoracic Mamillary Line & Abdomen
stages.desc: Descends along the carotid sheath (ST9 Renying) into the supraclavicular fossa (ST12). Deep internal branches penetrate the diaphragm to enter the Stomach and connect with the Spleen. The external trunk descends 4 cun lateral to the midline on the chest and 2 cun on the abdomen down to ST30 Qichong at the groin.

stages.title: Femoral Descent, Patella & Tibial Crest
stages.desc: Emerges at the inguinal crease, descends the anterior thigh along the rectus femoris muscle, crosses the patella into the lateral lower leg alongside the anterior tibial crest through ST36 Zusanli, and continues down the tibialis anterior muscle.

stages.title: Dorsum of Foot to Second Toe Terminus
stages.desc: Crosses the ankle joint and dorsum of the foot between the 2nd and 3rd metatarsals (ST41, ST42), terminating at the lateral nail corner of the 2nd toe at ST45 Lidui. A collateral separates at ST42 Chongyang and travels to the medial tip of the great toe to join SP1 Yinbai.

channels.name: Lung
channels.startLoc: Anterior-lateral chest wall, 1st intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline
channels.endLoc: Radial side of the thumb, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail
channels.pathway: Originates in the Middle Burner (stomach region), descends to connect with the Large Intestine, loops upward past the cardiac orifice, traverses the lungs, and ascends to the throat. It emerges antero-laterally at LU1 below the clavicle, runs down the antero-lateral aspect of the upper arm lateral to the biceps, crosses the cubital fossa (LU5), descends the radial forearm to the radial styloid and wrist crease (LU9), passes the thenar eminence (LU10), and terminates at the radial nail corner of the thumb at LU11. An internal branch separates at LU7 and travels directly to the radial index fingertip to connect with LI1.

startDetails.loc: In the 1st intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline, below the clavicle.

endDetails.loc: On the radial side of the thumb, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail.
endDetails.handoff: Collateral separates at LU7 to connect with LI1 (Index Finger)

organAffinities.tissues: Skin · Body Hair · Throat · Nasal Passages

stages.title: Middle Burner Internal Genesis
stages.desc: Originates internally in the Middle Burner (stomach region), descends to connect with and encircle the Large Intestine, turns back upward to skirt the cardiac orifice of the stomach, traverses the diaphragm, and enters the Lungs (its primary Zang organ).

stages.title: Respiratory Trunk & Axillary Emergence
stages.desc: Ascends the respiratory tract to the larynx and throat, then sweeps laterally to erupt superficially on the antero-lateral chest wall at LU1 Zhongfu (1st intercostal space), ascending to LU2 Yunmen directly below the clavicle.

stages.title: Brachial Descent & Cubital Traversal
stages.desc: Arches over the axilla, descends the antero-lateral border of the upper arm lateral to the biceps tendon, passes the cubital crease at LU5 Chize (He-Sea), and proceeds down the radial margin of the anterior forearm along the brachioradialis muscle.

stages.title: Styloid Wrist, Thenar Eminence & Acral Terminus
stages.desc: Traverses the radial styloid process at LU7 Lieque, crosses the wrist crease at LU9 Taiyuan (Yuan-Source), sweeps across the fleshy thenar eminence at LU10 Yuji, and terminates at the radial nail corner of the thumb at LU11 Shaoshang (Jing-Well). An internal branch divides at LU7 Lieque to meet LI1 Shangyang on the index finger.

channels.name: Large Intestine
channels.startLoc: Radial side of the index finger, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail
channels.endLoc: In the nasolabial groove, level with the midpoint of the lateral border of the ala nasi
channels.pathway: Begins at the radial corner of the index fingernail (LI1), travels along the radial border of the index finger and across the dorsum of the hand between the 1st and 2nd metacarpals (LI4 Hegu). It ascends the lateral anterior aspect of the forearm to the lateral elbow crease (LI11 Quchi), continues up the lateral upper arm over the deltoid prominence (LI15 Jianyu), crosses posterior to the shoulder joint to the upper back (GV14 Dazhui), and enters the supraclavicular fossa (ST12). Internally, a branch descends through the lungs, penetrates the diaphragm, and enters the Large Intestine. The external branch ascends the side of the neck, crosses the cheek, enters the lower gum and teeth, curves around the lips, crosses under the philtrum (GV26) to the opposite side of the nose, and terminates at LI20 beside the contralateral nostril to connect with ST1.

startDetails.loc: On the radial side of the index finger, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail.

endDetails.loc: In the nasolabial groove, level with the midpoint of the lateral border of the ala nasi.
endDetails.handoff: Internal link meets ST1 Chengqi at the infraorbital ridge

organAffinities.tissues: Large Intestine · Mucous Membranes · Teeth · Lower Gums

stages.title: Digital Ascent & Metacarpal Web
stages.desc: Commences at the radial nail angle of the index finger at LI1 Shangyang, ascends the radial margin of the finger across the 1st and 2nd metacarpal interspace at LI4 Hegu, and passes the anatomical snuffbox into the posterior-radial forearm.

stages.title: Lateral Forearm, Elbow Crease & Shoulder
stages.desc: Courses up the lateral radial border of the forearm between the extensor muscles, reaches the lateral elbow crease at LI11 Quchi, ascends the lateral arm over the deltoid insertion to the shoulder prominence at LI15 Jianyu, and converges at the spine at GV14 Dazhui.

stages.title: Supraclavicular Entry & Visceral Plunge
stages.desc: Arches over the shoulder into the supraclavicular fossa at ST12 Quepen; deep internal vessels plunge into the chest through the Lungs, penetrate the diaphragm, and enter the Large Intestine to regulate fluid absorption.

stages.title: Cervical Ascent, Oral Decussation & Nostril Terminus
stages.desc: The superficial branch ascends the lateral neck through the sternocleidomastoid muscle, traverses the mandible, enters the lower gums and lower teeth, encircles the lips, decussates (crosses over) under the philtrum at GV26, and terminates beside the opposite nostril at LI20 Yingxiang to meet ST1.

channels.name: Kidney
channels.startLoc: On the sole of the foot, between the 2nd and 3rd metatarsal bones, one-third of the distance from the web space to the heel
channels.endLoc: In the depression on the lower border of the clavicle, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline
channels.pathway: Originates on the plantar surface beneath the little toe, traverses diagonally across the sole of the foot to emerge at KI1 Yongquan. It passes under the tuberosity of the navicular bone (KI2), loops behind and inferior to the medial malleolus (KI3 Taixi), encircles the heel, ascends the postero-medial aspect of the lower leg (KI7 Fuliu), and reaches the medial side of the popliteal crease (KI10 Yingu). Ascending the posterior-medial thigh to the base of the spine, it enters the Kidney and connects with the Urinary Bladder. Emerging at the lower abdomen 0.5 cun lateral to the midline (KI11-KI16), it ascends through the abdomen and diaphragm, continuing up the chest 2 cun lateral to the midline (KI21-KI27), terminating just below the clavicle at KI27 Shufu. Deep branches ascend through the Liver, Lungs, and throat to terminate at the root of the tongue.

startDetails.loc: On the sole of the foot, between the 2nd and 3rd metatarsal heads, 1/3 distance from web to heel.

endDetails.loc: In the depression on the lower border of the clavicle, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline.

stages.title: Plantar Genesis & Retrograde Malleolar Loop
stages.desc: Begins on the plantar surface beneath the 5th toe, traverses diagonally across the sole to erupt at KI1 Yongquan, crosses the navicular tuberosity, and loops in a complete retrograde circle behind and below the medial malleolus at KI3 Taixi.

stages.title: Calcaneal Loop & Postero-Medial Popliteal Crease
stages.desc: Encircles the heel, ascends the postero-medial lower leg anterior to the Achilles tendon (KI7 Fuliu), reaches the medial end of the popliteal crease at KI10 Yingu, and ascends the medial thigh to the base of the spine at the coccyx.

stages.title: Abdominal & Thoracic Paramedian Ascent
stages.desc: Penetrates the Kidneys and Bladder; emerges on the lower abdomen 0.5 cun lateral to midline (KI11–KI16), ascends through the diaphragm, and continues up the chest 2 cun lateral to midline (KI21–KI27), terminating under the clavicle at KI27 Shufu.

stages.title: Hepato-Pulmonary Vessels & Lingual Root
stages.desc: Deep internal collaterals ascend through the Liver and Lungs, travel along the throat, and terminate at the root of the tongue, while an internal branch disperses from the chest into the Heart to link with the Pericardium channel.

channels.name: Bladder
channels.startLoc: In the depression 0.1 cun superior to the inner canthus of the eye
channels.endLoc: Lateral side of the fifth (little) toe, 0.1 cun posterior to the corner of the nail
channels.pathway: The longest channel in the human body (67 points). Originates at the inner canthus of the eye (BL1), ascends over the forehead to the vertex (BL7, GV20), enters the brain, emerges at the occiput, and descends to the nape of the neck at BL10 Tianzhu. From the neck, it divides into two bilateral descending tracks down the dorsal spine: the inner line (1.5 cun lateral to midline, BL11 to BL30 carrying the Back-Shu points) which descends into the lumbar area to enter the Kidneys and Bladder, continuing over the sacrum to the popliteal fossa (BL40 Weizhong); and the outer line (3.0 cun lateral to midline, BL41 to BL54) which descends through the scapular border, gluteal region, and posterior thigh to reunite with the inner line at BL40. The reunited channel descends down the middle of the posterior calf (BL57), curves behind the lateral malleolus (BL60 Kunlun), travels along the lateral margin of the foot (BL65), and terminates at the lateral nail corner of the little toe at BL67 Zhiyin, linking directly with KI1.

stages.title: Canthal Origin, Vertex Crown & Brain Entry
stages.desc: Originates at the inner eye canthus at BL1 Jingming, crosses the forehead to the vertex (BL7, GV20), enters the brain to communicate with cerebral marrow, and emerges at the occiput to descend to the nape of the neck at BL10 Tianzhu.

stages.title: Dual Bilateral Paravertebral Columns
stages.desc: Bifurcates at the neck into two parallel descending spinal columns: the Inner Line (1.5 cun lateral, housing all Back-Shu points BL11–BL30 which penetrate Kidneys and Bladder) and the Outer Line (3.0 cun lateral, BL41–BL54), both converging at the popliteal crease at BL40 Weizhong.

stages.title: Gastrocnemius Calf Descent to Lateral Malleolus
stages.desc: The reunited channel descends down the dorsal midline of the calf bellies through BL57 Chengshan, emerges lateral to the Achilles tendon, and winds behind the prominence of the lateral malleolus at BL60 Kunlun.

stages.title: Lateral Foot Margin to Fifth Toe Terminus
stages.desc: Courses along the lateral border of the foot past the tuberosity of the 5th metatarsal at BL65 Shugu, terminating at the lateral nail corner of the little toe at BL67 Zhiyin. A collateral branch dives into the plantar sole to link with KI1 Yongquan.
